_comment: Authoritative, portable description of the ANTSDR E310 V1 target.
Every value in the 'verified_from_upstream' sections was read directly out of
the pinned upstream sources listed in VERSION.json. Nothing here is inferred.
Values under 'project_assigned' are decisions made by THIS project and are not
vendor facts; they are recorded here so HDL, firmware, scripts and tests agree.
Machine-specific settings (COM port, tool paths, JTAG target) do NOT belong in
this file - they live in Source/Config/local.settings.json, which is per-PC and
is not part of the portable handoff (requirements 69, 70).

fpga.verified_how: get_parts xc7z020clg400-2 returned the part under Vivado 2026.1

rf_frontend.spi_control: PS7 SPI0 routed over EMIO to the AD9361 (spi_csn/spi_clk/spi_mosi/spi_miso)
rf_frontend.note_on_sample_rate: Sample rate, bandwidth, LO and gain are NOT fixed by the FPGA design. They are set at runtime by software over SPI. See Source/Firmware.

console_uart._baud_source: MEASURED from the live board 2026-09-11, not taken from the vendor header. Read UART1 registers over JTAG: BAUDGEN(0xE0001018)=0xAD=173, BAUDDIV(0xE0001034)=0x04, so divisor=(4+1)*173=865. UART_CLK_CTRL(0xF8000154) selects the IO PLL with divisor 10 -> 100 MHz reference. 100e6/865 = 115607 baud, i.e. 115200.
console_uart._baud_caution: The vendor header defines UART_BAUDRATE 921600, but that constant is used by the no-OS UART driver in IIO mode. The console (console.c / xil_printf) goes through the BSP stdout, which is 115200. Capturing at 921600 yields unreadable bytes.

address_map._comment: Byte addresses on the PS7 M_AXI_GP0 control path.

project_assigned._rationale: 0x43C0_0000 is the conventional free Zynq-7000 GP0 slot and collides with none of the upstream apertures above. Assigned by this project, not by MicroPhase.

interrupts.custom_ip_irq: none - gnss_passthrough is polled, it raises no interrupt

rf_switch_gpio._comment: EMIO GPIO indices as used by the standalone firmware, cross-checked against system_top.v gpio_o bit assignments.
rf_switch_gpio.WARNING: The band-select decode (which H/L combination selects which RF filter path) is a BOARD schematic property and is NOT derivable from the HDL or firmware sources in this repository. It must be read off the E310 V1 schematic before any assumption is made about which band is selected for 1575.42 MHz. Do not guess (requirement 32).

gnss_application._comment: Targets for the Phase-1 proof of concept. These are project requirements, not vendor facts.
gnss_application.datapath: AD9361 RX1 -> axi_ad9361 -> gnss_passthrough -> axi_ad9361 -> AD9361 TX1
gnss_application.test_method: conducted, coaxial, with external attenuation between TX1 and the GNSS receiver
UNRESOLVED: Sample rate and RF bandwidth for the L1 capture have not been chosen yet.
TX attenuation value and the resulting power at the GNSS receiver input have not been calculated yet.
These must be decided and recorded here before any RF test is run.
gnss_application.phase2_processing: 2-element LCMV CRPA (PIER C 2008, look + enforcement constraints, Source/HDL/crpa) inside gnss_passthrough on channel 0 when CONTROL[4] = 1: gain 1 toward LCMV_GPS_ANGLE, null toward LCMV_JAM_ANGLE. Angles come from software; no DOA estimation in the FPGA. No PL-NPI / PI core in this build.

custom_ip_register_map._comment: Mirrors the header comment in Source/HDL/gnss_passthrough.v. Offsets are from the base address in address_map.project_assigned.gnss_passthrough.

registers.name: ID
registers.note: ASCII 'GCP1'

registers.name: VERSION
registers.note: 1.0 = Phase-1 identity passthrough. 1.1 = adds the RX->TX sample alignment stage; a board reporting 1.0 transmits 24 dB low. 2.x = PL-NPI builds (not this design). 3.0 = LCMV CRPA build (CONTROL[4], 0x40/0x44/0x4C-0x6C, STATUS[17], [19], [22]), no PL-NPI. 3.1 = adds the 2x2 covariance estimator (0x90-0xA0) and PS-computed weights (CONTROL[5], 0x80-0x8C): the ARM solves w = R^-1 C (C^H R^-1 C)^-1 f.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.note: Bits [2]/[3] are axi_ad9361's read-back of (dac_data_sel == 4'h2), NOT an enable this block drives and NOT derived from the valid strobes (axi_ad9361_tx_channel.v:272). 0 means the DAC core is sourcing DDS and DISCARDING everything gnss_passthrough outputs, while TX_COUNT still advances. Firmware must write CHAN_CNTRL_7 (0x0418 + c*0x40) = 2.

registers.name: RX_SNAPSHOT_CH0
registers.note: {Q[31:16], I[15:0]}. RX format: 12-bit sample right-aligned in 16 bits, sign-extended into [15:12] (ad_datafmt.v with DATA_WIDTH 12).

registers.name: TX_SNAPSHOT_CH0
registers.note: {Q[31:16], I[15:0]}. TX format: 12-bit sample left-aligned, [15:4], because axi_ad9361_tx_channel.v:301 consumes dma_data[15:4]. In passthrough this reads 16x RX_SNAPSHOT_CH0; equal values mean the alignment stage is missing.

registers.name: LCMV_GPS_ANGLE
registers.note: [15:0] signed degrees -90..90 from broadside, look direction (gain 1). Reads back sign-extended.

registers.name: LCMV_JAM_ANGLE
registers.note: [15:0] signed degrees -90..90, null direction. theta > 0 reaches RX2 first.

registers.name: CRPA_COEF2
registers.note: Stored but unused (reserved).

registers.name: LCMV_EPS
registers.note: [15:0] Q0.16 enforcement value (gain toward the jammer), 0 = ideal null.

registers.name: LCMV_RX2_CAL
registers.note: {im[31:16], re[15:0]} Q2.14 RX2 correction c; applied as w2*conj(c).

registers.name: LCMV_W1_RE
registers.note: Q16.16 sign-extended active weight.

registers.name: LCMV_W2_RE
registers.note: Includes the RX2 calibration.

registers.name: LCMV_UPDATES
registers.note: Weight sets computed.

registers.name: LCMV_SAT_COUNT
registers.note: Output samples clipped to 12 bits; cleared by CONTROL[8].

registers.name: CRPA_COEF12..15
registers.note: 0x70-0x7C stored but unused.

registers.name: LCMV_SW_W1_RE
registers.note: PS weights, Q16.16, bits [24:0] used; final beamformer weights incl. RX2 calibration.

registers.name: LCMV_SW_W2_IM
registers.note: Writing this register commits all four weights atomically.

registers.name: COV_R11
registers.note: Covariance block average E[|x1|^2], Q.4 LSB^2, 4096-pair blocks of the raw ADC samples.

registers.name: COV_R12_RE
registers.note: E[x1 conj(x2)] real, signed Q.4.

registers.name: COV_R12_IM
registers.note: E[x1 conj(x2)] imaginary, signed Q.4.

registers.name: COV_BLOCKS
registers.note: Covariance blocks completed; read before and after R for a coherent set.
